read.q: How many customers do we have?
Which customers are from the UK?
read.gold: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE country='UK' ORDER BY name

read.q: How many orders were shipped in 2024?
read.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status='shipped' AND order_year=2024

read.q: What is the most expensive product?
read.gold: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1

read.q: What is the total revenue by product category?
read.gold: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity*p.price) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id=oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY 2 DESC

read.q: How many orders has each customer placed?
read.gold: SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.id) FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY c.name

read.q: List the products in the accessories category
read.gold: SELECT name FROM products WHERE category='accessories' ORDER BY name

read.q: Which country has the most customers?
read.gold: SELECT country, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY country ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

read.q: What is the average product price?

read.gold: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders) ORDER BY name
